title: How many clarinets he has owned
summary: Emile guesses he has had more than ten clarinets, around three in A and six or seven in B-flat.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: How many different clarinets have you had, would you guess? I know you couldn't remember all of them, I guess. You think maybe ten, or?
I think I had them in more than ten.
Yeah. I run into A, B, C, and A.
Yeah, for the Bs I had, I run into about three A's. For the Bs, I don't know, I run into about six or seven Bs. Yeah. Yeah. I rode all my carers.
